answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before it can trade: like a quill that only signs after its author deposits ink, the bond is slashed if the agent cheats and returned after honest work. A gale of fake identities then costs real capital per copy instead of being free, so creating thousands of Sybils drains the attacker's funds while honest agents keep a safe haven for trade, since one bond buys only one trusted seat.
